'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed in an apartment block fire in [[Hartland, Wisconsin]], [[United States]]. Local police say that an "active criminal investigation" is underway. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/dead-apartment-fire-wisconsin/story?id=91866811 (ABC News)] 
*At least seven people are killed and four others are injured in a road accident in [[Lima]], [[Peru]]. [http://english.news.cn/20221022/48f4cd8101de45539aef7170707a6bd8/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Mexico]] reports its first case of the highly pathogenic [[H5N1]] virus in a wild, non-poultry bird in [[Metepec]], [[State of Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-reports-first-h5n1-bird-flu-case-2022-10-21/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Venezuela relations]]
**The last five members of an [[Iran]]ian cargo plane with [[Venezuela]]n crew arrive in [[Caracas]] after four months in Argentine custody, where a court seized the plane on suspicions of terrorism at the request of a US court. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/last-plane-crew-detained-argentina-reach-venezuela-2022-10-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2022 Pakistani constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Election Commission of Pakistan]] bans former [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|prime minister]] [[Imran Khan]] from seeking an elected office in the [[Government of Pakistan|government]] for five years, citing Khan's deceit in declaring some of the gifts that he received from foreign dignitaries during [[Premiership of Imran Khan|his premiership]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20221021-former-pakistan-pm-khan-barred-from-elections-for-five-years (France 24)]
*[[2022 British Columbia New Democratic Party leadership election]]
**[[David Eby]] is acclaimed as the leader of the [[British Columbia New Democratic Party]] and becomes the next [[Premier of British Columbia]] following the disqualification of his sole opponent, climate activist Anjali Appadurai. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/david-eby-become-premier-canadas-british-columbia-province-2022-10-20/ (Reuters)]
